question: How many products are there in each product category?
sql: SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY product_category_name ORDER BY product_count DESC;

question: What is the average product price for each product category?
sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS average_price FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY average_price DESC;

question: Which 10 product categories generated the highest revenue?
sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What are the top 10 product categories by number of products, using English category names?
sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products p JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which product categories have an average item price greater than 100?
sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS average_price FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name HAVING AVG(oi.price) > 100 ORDER BY average_price DESC;
